page.notes: The "=" after "Romano" is a printer's ornament, not a letter. The first title lines, the italic line "Adiectum est..." and the verse reference and date are printed in red; the rest is black. "Ecce" is written "Eccè" and "hostē" carries a macron as printed. The initial "A" of "Acta" is a decorated capital. Spellings such as "quoq;", "praecipuè" and "hostē" are kept as printed. Left out: the vertical rule at the left edge of the scan, which is not printed text.
